title: Uttara Khanda - The Afterlife
summary: Detailed accounts of the soul's journey after death, funeral rites, and the laws of karma.
ai_summary: The Uttara Khanda is a profound treatise on the afterlife. It demystifies death, outlining the karmic consequences of one's actions and the significance of ancestral rites (Shraddha) in ensuring peace for the departed soul.

verses.sanskrit:
गौतमो वाच ।
कर्मणा केन गच्छन्ति यमलोकं नरा भुवि ।
verses.transliteration:
gautamo vāca |
karmaṇā kena gacchanti yamalokaṃ narā bhuvi |
verses.translation: Gautama said: By what karma do men on earth go to the realm of Yama?

layers.content: गौतम ने कहा: पृथ्वी पर मनुष्य किस कर्म के कारण यमलोक जाते हैं?
गौतम म्हणाले: पृथ्वीवरील माणसे कोणत्या कर्मामुळे यमलोकात जातात?

layers.author: sankara
layers.content: The inquiry into karma is fundamental. It implies that the afterlife is not arbitrary but directly governed by the ethical weight of actions performed during one's lifetime.

layers.author: dnyaneshwari
layers.content: कर्माचा सिद्धांत अटळ आहे. जसे पेराल तसे उगवते, हा निसर्गाचा नियम मृत्यूनंतरही लागू पडतो, हेच यातून सुचवले आहे.
